source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 箫笛相和白衣初现
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC07 after EP02 SC06 formal test-mode segment. Use this to plan the next 8-10 second short-drama shots through ComfyUI.
title: 箫笛相和，白衣初现

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC06 is approved only for pipeline validation. SH04 white dragon-deer face drift should be tightened in production.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 突然身后有箫声扬起，错落合韵。拓拔野欣喜若狂，回头叫道：“前辈！”
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野吹起竹笛后，身后忽有洞箫声应和。他以为是神农归来，惊喜回头，却发现月下竹间并非神农，而是一位白衣女子。女子持玛瑙洞箫，神情清冷淡远；拓拔野与白龙鹿都被她的气质震住。女子放下洞箫，淡然询问方才的笛声是否出自他手。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 拓拔野因白衣女子的出现而失神，随后的对话与人物关系将进入新阶段。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute in hand or slipping from hand, Wufeng in a bamboo sheath at the right waist.
White dragon-deer remains a friendly mythic companion; avoid turning it into an ordinary deer.

White-clothed woman should be an adult, elegant, distant, and rain/water-associated; use the existing adult Yushiqie reference as the safest visual anchor, but keep her identity as first reveal unless later script confirms name.
Do not sexualize, infantilize, or romanticize with body-emphasis. The emotional beat is awe, shock, and mythic encounter.
The setting remains moonlit Tianhu bamboo pavilion, lake reflection, incense smoke, bamboo shadows.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, or plaques.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may describe Chinese short-drama style, but must request no readable screen text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no flute/xiao audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, flute/xiao sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable reveal, reaction, and subtle head/hand movement. Avoid complex instrument-playing animation or fast turnarounds.
